values: 对敌人造成伤害并眩晕，切换持枪战斗；或对敌人造成高额真实伤害，切换持剑战斗。
Vala switches to Skyblaster Mode to deal damage and stun the enemy, or to Sword Mode to inflict massive true damage on her target.

选择空地图格释放时，切换为持枪战斗，同时自己跳跃至该格位置，狙击一名敌人，优先以“预告”的敌人作为目标，对其造成450% + 40% ATK伤害并眩晕，持续4秒；选择敌人释放时，切换为持剑战斗，普通攻击变为近战，并以敏捷的速度穿到其面前刺击，对其造成420% + 25% ATK的真实伤害。自动战斗时，若“预告”的目标生命值比例低于50%，则优先切换为持剑并攻击该目标；否则优先切换为持枪并远离敌人。

When Vala casts the skill at an empty tile, she jumps to the tile and switches to Skyblaster Mode. She prioritizes shooting the marked enemy, dealing 450% + 40% ATK damage and stunning them for 4s. 
When Vala casts the skill at an enemy, she switches to Sword Mode. She rushes to slash the target, dealing 420% + 25% ATK true damage. And all her normal attacks become melee attacks. 
In Auto Battle, Vala switches to Sword Mode and prioritizes the marked enemy if their HP ratio is lower than 50%. Otherwise, she switches to Skyblaster Mode to shoot the enemy and remains at a safe distance.
持枪时，自身普通攻击和技能对生命值百分比高于50%的敌人造成的伤害提高40%。
In Skyblaster Mode, Vala deals 40% more damage to enemy with a HP ratio higher than 50%.
持剑时，自身普通攻击和技能对生命值百分比低于50%的敌人，造成目标已损失生命值10%的额外伤害，该伤害最高不超过自身300%攻击力。
In Sword Mode, Vala's normal attacks and skills deal extra damage to enemy with a HP ratio lower than 50%. Damage dealt equals to 10% of the target's lost HP, up to 300% of Vala's ATK.
持枪时，自身普通攻击和技能对生命值百分比高于50%的敌人造成的伤害提高45%。
In Skyblaster Mode, Vala deals 45% more damage to enemy with a HP ratio higher than 50%.
持剑时，自身普通攻击和技能对生命值百分比低于50%的敌人，造成目标已损失生命值12%的额外伤害，该伤害最高不超过自身300%攻击力。
In Sword Mode, Vala's normal attacks and skills deal extra damage to enemy with a HP ratio lower than 50%. Damage dealt equals to 12% of the target's lost HP, up to 300% of Vala's ATK.
对敌人发出“预告”，自身优先攻击“预告”的敌人并且会吸收能量。
Vala sends a notice to mark an enemy. She prioritizes attacking the marked enemy and absorbs their Energy.
战斗开始时，对最远的敌人发出“预告”，自身会优先攻击“预告”的敌人，并且每次攻击时会吸收90 + 10点能量。当“预告”的敌人被击败后，维拉夫人会立即根据自身当前持枪或持剑分别对离自身最远或最近的敌人使用“行动预告”。

Vala sends a notice to mark the farthest enemy when a battle starts. She prioritizes attacking the noticed enemy, absorbing 90 + 10 Energy for each hit. When the noticed enemy is defeated, Vala sends a new notice to mark the farthest enemy if she is in Skyblaster Mode or to the nearest enemy if she is in Sword Mode.
对敌人造成伤害并降低急速；或对敌人造成三次伤害。
Vala deals damage to an enemy and reduces their Haste, or hits an enemy 3 times.
持枪时，发射一枚特制的麻痹弹，造成230% + 20% ATK伤害并使得敌人急速降低60点，持续8秒；持剑时，以迅捷之姿朝敌人进行连击，造成3段100% + 8% ATK伤害并使其眩晕，持续1秒。

In Skyblaster Mode, Vala shoots with an exclusive anesthetic bullet, dealing 230% + 20% ATK damage to an enemy and reducing their Haste by 60 for 8s. 
In Sword Mode, Vala hits the enemy 3 times, dealing 100% + 8% ATK damage each hit and stunning them for 1s.
持枪时，伤害提升至240% + 20% ATK；持剑时，每段伤害提升至105% + 8% ATK。
Increases bullet damage to 240% + 20% ATK or each sword hit damage to 105% + 8% ATK.
持枪时，伤害提升至250% + 20% ATK；持剑时，每段伤害提升至110% + 8% ATK。
Increases bullet damage to 250% + 20% ATK or each sword hit damage to 110% + 8% ATK.
持枪时，伤害提升至260% + 20% ATK；持剑时，每段伤害提升至115% + 8% ATK。
Increases bullet damage to 260% + 20% ATK or each sword hit damage to 115% + 8% ATK.
提高自身攻击力，有非召唤物敌军被击败后进一步提升攻击力。
Vala increases her ATK during battle. She gains extra ATK every time a non-summoned enemy is defeated.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升9%。且当有非召唤物敌军被击败后，额外提升3%攻击力。
Vala increases her ATK by 9% during battle. She also gains an extra 3% ATK every time a non-summoned enemy is defeated.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升12%。且当有非召唤物敌军被击败后，额外提升4%攻击力。
Vala increases her ATK by 12% during battle. She also gains an extra 4% ATK every time a non-summoned enemy is defeated.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升15%。且当有非召唤物敌军被击败后，额外提升5%攻击力。
Vala increases her ATK by 15% during battle. She also gains an extra 5% ATK every time a non-summoned enemy is defeated.
“预告”的敌人被击败后，自身移动速度和急速提升。
Vala increases her movement speed and Haste when the marked enemy is defeated.
“预告”的敌人被击败后，自身身形融入夜色，不会被敌人优先选为目标，自身移动速度提高60%，急速提高80点，持续10秒。

Vala blends into the darkness when the marked enemy is defeated, making her untargetable until all other allies are defeated. During this time, her movement speed increases by 60% and Haste by 80 for 10s.
该状态下自身移动速度提高80%，急速提高100点。
Increases her movement speed by 80% and Haste by 100 when in the darkness.
“预告”的敌人被击败后，自身立即回复40%的最大生命值。
Recovers 40% of her max HP when the marked enemy is defeated.
该状态下自身移动速度提高90%，急速提高120点。
Increases her movement speed by 90% and Haste by 120 when in the darkness.
对“预告”的敌人造成伤害提高。
Vala deals a higher damage to the marked enemy.
自身对“预告”的敌人造成的伤害提高10%。
Vala increases her damage dealt to the marked enemy by 10%.
“预告”的敌人造成的伤害降低20%。自身持枪时，每次攻击预告的敌人吸收的能量提升100点；持剑时，额外提升30点终结。

Enemies marked by Notice Beforehand deal 20% less damage. While in Skyblaster mode, Vala gains 100 more Energy every time she attacks the marked enemy. In Sword mode, she instead gains an extra 30 Execution.
